items.sentence: She was denied her repeated request for reasonable accommodation from [MASK], to her termination on January 22, 2021; 2 and 2.
She was charged as Absent Without Leave (AWOL) from [MASK], to her termination on January 22, 2021.
The record indicates that Complainant was appointed as a Primary Care Physician at the Agency on [MASK], subject to a two-year probationary period.
Complainant indicated that she sustained a shoulder injury on [MASK].
We note that Complainant did not claim that she notified her supervisors or requested a reasonable accommodation at the time of her [MASK] injury.
